preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 100, inclusive.
The number of integers in the array is between 3 and 1000, inclusive.
Each integer in the array is between 0 and 10^9, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: The sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 2000
preconditions.description: The total number of integers across all test cases does not exceed 2000.

postconditions.expression: output == 'NO' or (output == 'YES' and B and C)
postconditions.description: The output is either 'NO' if no such permutations exist, or 'YES' followed by two lines of N integers each representing B and C.
If the output is 'YES', then there exist permutations B and C of the input array A such that no subarray B[i:j] is equal to any subarray C[i:j] for 1 ≤ i ≤ j ≤ N and (i, j) ≠ (1, N).
If the output is 'YES', then B and C are permutations of the input array A.
